newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler cuts interest rates on Grand Cherokees.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler cuts interest rates on Grand Cherokees.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Thursday it is offering qualified buyers of new 1997 Jeep Grand Cherokee models reduced interest rates on Chrysler Financial Corp financing.
The program, which runs from June 26 through September 2, 1997, offers Chrysler financing to qualified Grand Cherokee buyers at an annual percentage rate of 4.8 percent for loans up to 48 months.
A Chrysler spokesman said the automaker previously did not offer an incentive rate on Grand Cherokee financing. Rates for the financing had been based on prevailing interest rates.
